seo.title: 中文包装媒体｜冷烫和热烫有什么区别？ / Difference Between Cold Foil and Hot Foil Stamping

content:
# 中文回答

冷烫和热烫都能做金属效果，但工艺逻辑不同。热烫是通过烫金版、温度、压力和停留时间，把烫金膜上的装饰层转移到纸张、塑料、皮革等底材上。它适合高端礼盒、酒盒、化妆品盒、书刊封面、皮革 Logo 等强调质感的场景。

冷烫一般先在印刷机上把胶或 UV 胶印到指定位置，再把箔层转移到胶层区域。它适合标签、柔印、联线高速生产和大批量装饰。冷烫效率高，但对胶水、UV 固化、底材表面张力和膜匹配要求高。

简单判断：追求厚重、高端、局部质感，优先考虑热烫；追求高速联线、大面积标签装饰，可考虑冷烫。无论哪种工艺，都不能脱离底材和设备参数谈效果，必须用客户实际材料打样。

# English Answer

Cold foil and hot foil can both create metallic effects, but the process logic is different. Hot foil stamping uses a heated die, pressure, and dwell time to transfer the decorative layer from foil to paper, plastic, leather, or other substrates. It is suitable for premium gift boxes, wine boxes, cosmetic boxes, book covers, and leather logos where a high-end tactile effect is needed.

Cold foil usually applies adhesive or UV adhesive to the target area first, then transfers foil only to that adhesive area. It is suitable for labels, flexo printing, inline high-speed production, and large-volume decoration. Cold foil can be efficient, but it depends heavily on adhesive, UV curing, substrate surface energy, and foil matching.

Simple rule: choose hot foil for premium depth and local decoration; consider cold foil for high-speed inline label decoration. In both cases, the final result must be tested on the customer’s actual material and machine.
